dtsPropsFor.ClosedCard:
/**
   * A canteen with no menu for this day. The card keeps the full silhouette of a
   * FoodCard — same radius, same height, same slot in the row — and swaps the
   * dish photo for an empty place setting, because a gap in the row reads as a
   * bug while a card saying "Ingen servering" reads as an answer.
   *
   * `imagePath` is that place setting. There are exactly three, at
   * images_nobg/closed-plates/closed-plate-{1,2,3}.png, and getClosedPlateUrl()
   * hashes "<canteen>-<day>" to choose one — so a canteen keeps the same setting
   * all day, and three closed canteens in one row show three different ones
   * rather than the same stock picture repeated. They differ in the napkin fold,
   * the cutlery and the herb: parallel fork and knife with rosemary, crossed
   * cutlery with lavender, a draped napkin with spoon and fork and thyme.
   */
  data: { canteenName: string; canteen: { week: string; openingHours: string }; mainDish?: { dish: string; allergens: { id: string; name: string }[]; isMain: boolean }; sideDishes?: { dish: string; allergens: { id: string; name: string }[]; isMain: boolean }[]; mainAllergens?: { id: string; name: string }[]; description?: string | null; displayDishName?: string | null; origin?: { code: string; country: string } | null; imagePath?: string; highResImagePath?: string; isOutdated?: boolean; isAhead?: boolean; canteenWeekNum?: number; availabilityNotes?: string[] };
  cardIdx: number;
dtsPropsFor.SkeletonCard:
/** Stagger, in ms, so a row of skeletons pulses in sequence rather than together. */
  delay?: number;
dtsPropsFor.ClosedCanteensPill:
/** Renders nothing when empty. Names the closed canteens in a tooltip. */
  closedCanteens: { canteenName: string; canteen: { week: string; openingHours: string }; mainDish?: { dish: string; allergens: { id: string; name: string }[]; isMain: boolean }; sideDishes?: { dish: string; allergens: { id: string; name: string }[]; isMain: boolean }[]; mainAllergens?: { id: string; name: string }[]; description?: string | null; displayDishName?: string | null; origin?: { code: string; country: string } | null; imagePath?: string; highResImagePath?: string; isOutdated?: boolean; isAhead?: boolean; canteenWeekNum?: number; availabilityNotes?: string[] }[];
